name: NextUI
notes: NextUI has no extension filter. Every file of a Roms folder that is not hidden is listed as a game (os workspace/all/nextui/nextui.c:535-547), so the rows carry no extensions.
A Roms folder starts the pak named by the text inside its last parentheses, or by its whole name without parentheses (getEmuName, os workspace/all/common/utils.c:352-379).
BIOS sits in Bios/<TAG>/, two levels under the card root, so the roms root is ../../Roms from it.
